statement: GB300 cloud rental quotes conflict across aggregators, at $8.62 per GPU-hour on one and $4.31 on another
why: Two aggregators disagree by roughly a factor of two on the same part, so no single rental level can be trusted yet.

impact.mechanism: Unresolved price dispersion on the newest rack-scale part means rental cost references for it are unreliable; static level only.

evidence.source: aggregated web search (IntuitionLabs, GPU Battle, JarvisLabs, getdeploying.com)
evidence.excerpt: sources disagree on GB300 rental figure ($8.62/hr vs $4.31/hr on computeprices.com) -- flagging the discrepancy rather than resolving it

confidence.basis: Secondary aggregators openly conflict; the document flags rather than resolves the discrepancy.
